name: Merle Beltran
source: Merle is one of the seven brothers who make up "The Murder" - a well known think tank and group of information brokers within the paranormal community. With his brothers, he operates a cafe by the same ame. This cafe functions as their source of normal income as well as the headquarters for their paranormal shop. Both shops exist in the same place but on different planes to prevent normal humans from entering the paranormal side. It was originally Merle's idea to create and run a real cafe to their headquarters.
